status: DRAFT: not frozen, not adopted; every FREEZE value is filled, and every regex checked against the frozen build's symbol table, before registration

leader.solo_note: parallel::solo calls bwt::build then bwt::walk_segments_room; if the frozen build inlines it, the freeze names an attributable symbol or an instruction-range map instead (never a zero)

oracle: the record of `ab child lbzip2 1 FILE` (the same hash over lbzip2's output), frozen below; the screen re-runs it and requires the frozen values

fixtures.block_classes: FREEZE: the 431 blocks' classes in order (T: rows >= MIN_COOP, S: below), from `scan`

edit.byte: FREEZE: floor(mid bit of block B / 8)

fixtures.block: FREEZE: a T block, not the first

expect.out: FREEZE: the blocks before B, decoded

fixtures.block: FREEZE: an S block between two T blocks

edit.bit: FREEZE: the block's start_bit + 48 + 31 (the stored CRC's last bit, from scan's span)

lbzip2_check: each E fixture: `lbzip2 -dc` exits nonzero (rejection only; its text and buffered output are not compared)
transitions_covered_by: FREEZE: from W's block_classes and the E fixtures; a crafted fixture is added for any required transition W lacks
full_tier_at_9: DEFERRED: needs an explicit team/block mapping and per-team assigned-block counts, which the checker cannot yet establish

pr.T1: uninstrumented A1: 4 arms x 11 fixtures, 7 oracle decodes, 4 lbzip2 rejections (team_screen.py outputs)
pr.T2: walk-stats probes on the head (and on the base once the instrument is on master): roles, kernel entry counts, forbidden-walker counter 0, liveness, per-block conservation, transitions; NOT YET IMPLEMENTED

full.A2-A4: callgrind of H-team and B-team on W, uninstrumented builds, each profile with its own binary and source (team_screen.py check); an unattributable kernel is UNATTRIBUTED, never zero; the base is never patched
full.at_9: deferred until an explicit team identity exists

checksum_scope: length plus the harness's 64-bit non-cryptographic hash: a regression checksum, not byte-exact proof (open: add a SHA-256 of the stream)
error_fields: the child's record: err_kind and err_block (examples/ab.rs, from the reader's mibz2::Error)
